title: trust_mapper limitation: inline guards
summary: trust_mapper classifies (anyone, internal, mod:onlyX, role:Y) by reading modifiers + visibility only. Functions with INLINE access guards (status checks, require msg.sender ==, initialized flag) get tagged 'anyone' incorrectly. On Base Azul multiproof produced 11 false-alarm hypotheses on AggregateVerifier (challenge/nullify/resolve all status-guarded but flagged anyone) and 5 on NitroEnclaveVerifier (mixing internal _set helpers with onlyOwner setters).
key_lesson: Tune trust_mapper: scan first 200 bytes of body for revert/require patterns referencing msg.sender, status, initialized, paused. Treat as effective modifier. Reduces FP rate on bridge/dispute systems where state-machine guards dominate over modifier guards.
